subject: Update on Your Job Application
body: Dear [Name], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to provide you with an update on your recent job application with our company. We have completed the initial round of interviews and are impressed with your qualifications. We would like to invite you for a final interview next week to discuss further details. Please let me know your availability so we can schedule a convenient time. Looking forward to hearing from you soon. Best regards, [Company Name]
